[url=https://youtu.be/ZvDW-NTQjFw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24570646/ae77136e8f8fa09fc2c0df8f4f1eadb00413fc9d.png[/img][/url]

Greetings, Hot Lava fans! We can’t wait for you to jump in to our newest update featuring:

[h1]BRAND NEW CHARACTERS![/h1]
Get ready for a new in-game toy universe EXO-CLASH!. Set in another galaxy where giant robots fight colossal monsters. Captain Hera Scarlet and Lt Leo Satomi have landed in the game complete with their own unique unlockable items, taunts, and Action Files.

[h1]NEW WEEKLY MODE![/h1]
There’s now even more reason to jump into Hot Lava regularly with the weekly course. Compete with others for top global positions on a new course and ability each week. Earn a reward for placing on the leaderboard then try again when it cycles to a new course each Tuesday.

[h1]SUMMER ACTIVITIES![/h1]
Splash into summer with water balloons and more when you visit the Playground in the next few weeks. Challenge someone to a water balloon fight, or hit all the targets around the level for your chance at earning a reward. These activities will only be around during summer so hit your mark while you can!

You can enjoy all the features of this dynamic new update right now. Meanwhile, we’ll keep working on ways to make our game even hotter. So stay tuned, stay cool and stay off the floor!

[list]
[*]Beat the weekly course and earn a reward
[*]Play as Hera or Leo from the Exo-Clash universe
[*]Throwable water balloons now available in Playground Level
[*]Hit all the targets to earn a cool new accessory
[*]Checkpoints added to Chase Your Sister courses
[*]Level up faster with increased XP gains across the board
[/list]

notes.title: Hot Lava Fall Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24570646/9773f5e184cdebb6f5398a6686509a6dbb5a8e8e.png[/img]
[h3]ROCCO’S ARCADE IS FULLY OPEN![/h3]
Hey Hot Lava fans, we found the keys to some hidden places in Rocco's Arcade so we opened them up for you to explore. Have fun leaping through 4 new courses and a plethora of added trials!
[h3]MORE ARCADE FUN![/h3]
As seen in our last update, our Rocco’s Arcade Level is rollicking good retro-arcade fun. Well, good news, we added four - count ‘em four -  new courses hidden in Roccos’ back rooms! Plus a plethora of new trials - jetpack, pogo, buddy and tiny toy. AND all new collectable cards just laying around for anyone to grab. You’ll have to explore all over this map to find it all! 
[h3]MORE CHALLENGES! [/h3]
With the new courses comes a host of new challenges to complete - pick up more than 30 new stars! Level up!
[h3]NIFTY NEW ITEMS [/h3]
We’ve also added new collectable accessory sets, including G.A.T’s new K.A.P.O.W. mech armor, and a sweet VR headset and suit combo! The more you play, the more you collect, so jump back in and check out all the new stuff! 

There are always plenty of daily challenges and oodles of online opponents to race against. So we’ll see you all there! Stay cool, stay safe and stay off the floor!

notes.title: It's Klei Fest! - Updates and Announcements For All Things Klei!
notes.content:
Hey Everybody!

It’s time for our big [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/kleifest]annual publisher sale[/url] on Steam!

During Klei Fest, we’ll have a big burst of content, items, events, sales and interesting stuff happening for all things Klei! And this year’s fest is bigger than ever.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2ePxO4EBzFY][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/112393/6f61c123395fd88cf85211fdaa34f062cf9293e2.png[/img][/url]
[h2]Hot Lava: Say hello to two new characters:[/h2] T. Rex and Venomess - two rocking reptilian members of Mutant Mayhem! A brand new Klei Created map, Rocco’s Arcade is a hotbed of hopping set in a retro-arcade pizza place. Of course with a new map and characters we have two new courses, and plenty of new collectables and accessories!

[h3]AWESOME ARCADE UPDATE[/h3]
Greetings Hot Lava fans! As the weather heats up, so does your favorite game with a brand-spanking new update to warm your heart. 

[h3]BRAND! NEW! MAP![/h3]
Hold onto your pizza slices, it’s a brand new Klei created map! Rocco’s Arcade is a hotbed of hopping set in a retro-arcade pizza place. Check out two new courses! Take on the pogo and tiny toy trials! Interact with gobs of retro-games like Flamly Ball, Zeet-ball and Thump-a-Raccoon! 

[h3]TWO NEW CHARACTERS[/h3]
Say hello to two new characters: T. Rex and Venomess - two rocking reptilian members of Mutant Mayhem! Select them on the character screen and level them up to unlock a cavalcade of new collectables!
[h3]
NEW ITEMS [/h3]
On top of all the awesome items you can get leveling up the characters, we also have a handful of bonus cool collectable sets of accessories. The more you play, the more you collect, so jump back in and check out all the new stuff. We have plenty of daily challenges and plenty of online opponents to race against. See you all there!

As always, stay cool, stay safe and stay off the floor!

For more details on the Hot Lava update check out the patch notes!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/382560/Hot_Lava/

For more details on the Hot Lava update [url=https://klei.gg/HLCurrentUpdate]check out the patch notes[/url]!

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Oxygen Not Included: [/h2]Our new content pack called "Fast Friends" includes some big performance boosts in both the base game and Spaced Out! DLC. We also have four new Duplicants, four new critter morphs and a dozen brand new Duplicant outfits craftable at the Clothing Refashionator building.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/457140/Oxygen_Not_Included/

For more details on the Oxygen Not Included update [url=https://klei.gg/ONICurrentUpdate]check out the patch notes[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24570646/ede8a8a9c800dae513ea7c68ed7267594af8a4e7.png[/img]

[h2]Don't Starve Together: [/h2]The enigmatic Corvus Goodfeather returns with a bunch of new prizes and three new games during the Midsummer Cawnival!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/322330/Dont_Starve_Together/

For more details on the Don't Starve Together Update [url=https://klei.gg/DSTCurrentUpdate]check out the patch notes[/url]!

[hr][/hr]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24570646/a6adffe53cd40f157bf9a27a5562f68690b8b137.png[/img]

[h2]Introducing Klei Publishing![/h2]
We have teamed up will a couple of great game studios to publish two new games coming in 2023! 

Check them out and don't forget to wishlist them on Steam and show them some love! 

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AY_t0kmRq_k][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24570646/04b931eb691e9f374a7ca8ea25362bc2bd32e8e4.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Lab Rat [/h2]

Chump Squad, the developer of Kine brings us Lab Rat. In this satirical adventure a metrics-obsessed AI will monitor, profile, and entertain you as you progress through over a hundred genre-bending puzzles.. 

Lab Rat even has a demo available now! More details on this game will come in future announcements. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304610/Lab_Rat/

[hr][/hr]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NIBJbrW7uuY][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24570646/4cf0925a760046ab7e374ee663dbdcffa005b6c1.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Mind Over Magic[/h2]

Our friends at Sparkypants bring us Mind Over Magic. Design, build and manage your magic school to explore what lies below. Study lost arcana, grow exotic plants, brew potions, and raise undead servants -- only you can prepare your fragile students to harness their Mind Over Magic.

More details on this game will come in future announcements.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]And announcing a new game from Klei coming soon![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/112393/be1e084e54c9859150d93b4b358c9abf19a7f0af.png[/img]

You will be able to check out the official teaser trailer for Rotwood during the [url=https://www.pcgamingshow.com/]PC Gaming Show[/url] on June 12th!

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Woah, that's a lot of stuff. [/h2]
Thanks for checking out all of our games and for all your continued support. Have fun out there!

[h2]NEW! T.O.X.I.C. Team-up[/h2][/url]
A brand new update brings two brand new members to the T.O.X.I.C. roster: Poizone’s robotic army, the Infected Infantry! And Lord Sludge’s molten magma monster form, the 
Megamortabeast!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24570646/cd9b9f0077e2d87ba8c96786b629bc6abc6bfdf4.png[/img]
[h2]NEW! Vault Jump Ability[/h2]
Along with these hot new characters comes one cool new move, the Vault Jump! Give yourself an extra boost to reach those platforms that are just a *little* too far away. And if you’re bummed you can’t test out this new move with your favorite characters...well we’ve got some news for you!

[h2]NEW! Choice[/h2]
We’ve decoupled abilities from their characters so you can now use any character you want with any ability: Sue Nami with Double Jump; Poizone with Boost; Hazard with Slide Jump - go ahead and mix it up!

You also might notice some slick new UI in the game designed to make your lava jumping experience all the more pleasant.

[h2]NEW! Items[/h2]
Every character’s progression levels have been bumped up to 60 possible levels. So get in there and jump around to unlock some new stickers, action files, emotes, and new skins. As an added bonus we’re also giving everyone free Sea Stealth G.A.T. skins for this Spring update, just because we love you all so much.
 
If you can’t get enough of all things G.A.T., there are all new G.A.T. lore descriptions for Head, Back, and Trinket accessories. Read through them all to learn about the exploits of all your favorite characters.

[h2]NEW! Leaderboards[/h2]
You asked. We listened. Leaderboards are now split up by ability so you can save separate times and replays for each one. Unfortunately (or fortunately depending on your times) we had to reset leaderboards to accomplish this. Fear not, your locally saved replays are still available in their original directory, but your times pulled from Steam will be reset. 

As a bonus feature we’ve also added the ability to change your profile. Free yourself from the tyranny of sharing times with your little sister! Or, if you just want to experience the thrill of unlocking all your items again, now is the perfect time to jump in and get moving. Let the competition begin!

Stay safe. Stay cool. And stay off the floor!

notes.title: Jen Forcer's Tactical Training Updates (Roadmap - 2021)
notes.content:
Originally posted by [url=https://forums.kleientertainment.com/forums/topic/123309-hot-lava-roadmap/]DanaS on the official forums[/url]:

It has been just over a year since Hot Lava launched on Steam and Apple Arcade and we wanted to check in with our amazing fans to say thanks and update everyone about some of the exciting things we have planned for the future.

[h2]Previously on… Hot Lava[/h2]

Our fantastic fan base was instrumental and inspirational in aiding the team to polish Hot Lava through the thrilling beta phase of development. Their heroic feedback pushed the boundaries of what this game could be and epically cheered us on as we equipped Hot Lava with bigger and better challenges. We cannot stress enough how crucial our fans were in this truly transformative time.

Along with our monumental release, a thrilling new audience appeared thanks to Apple Arcade! This new audience showed us that people were just as enthusiastic about jumping around in molten hot environments on mobile as on PC. 

Over the past year we’ve been pummeled with a lot of positive feedback and some sensational suggestions about how to make Hot Lava more accessible to newer players and to seasoned pros.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24570646/23b52cc3b5934c190b5d5548d58329aa6dddcba6.jpg[/img]

[h2]And now...[/h2]

Our newest update introduced two T.O.X.I.C. new characters -- Lord Sludge and Poizone -- armed with two new movesets. Poizone’s double jump gives players a way to leap to some hard to reach spots and Lord Sludge’s slide moves provide an alternative to hitting those higher speeds previously only achievable by mastering our boost system.

Teaming up with these new characters is our amazing new progression system that introduced a whole new set of rewards: sensational new skins and character-specific items that are unlocked when players level-up their character and awesome new Action Files to fill you in on lots of G.A.T. and T.O.X.I.C. trivia.

Apple Arcade users with LiDAR-equipped devices also got an added treat in Hot Lava’s incredible new AR feature. Finally, people at home can enjoy the fun of having molten hot lava fill their living room without all the messy clean up.

We’ve gotten some great feedback on these new features, including suggestions on what you want to see. So, on that note, we’d like to let you in on what we have planned for Hot Lava: Year 2.

[h2]Next Time on Hot Lava...[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24570646/cd5ef0fa1f064d3f4f3b25207463b3ded71fb61f.jpg[/img]
[h2]Jen Forcer’s Tactical Training Updates[/h2]

Our mission moving forward is to make the game more accessible to newer players while still challenging veteran players with four phases of fantastic updates we’re calling ‘[b]Jen Forcer’s Tactical Training Updates[/b]’ periodically deploying throughout the coming year. Updates that fall under a few categories:

[h2]Menu and Early Course Overhaul[/h2]
We’re on a mission to improve our user experience. It’s our duty to leave no Hot Lava player behind, whether they’re hardcore veteran players or rookies who just jumped in. With this in mind we’ll be shining up and shipping out improvements to our menu system. Things like making it more apparent where your items and unlockables are and implementing a replay saving system that will bring videos of your runs front and center so they’re easier to locate.

notes.title: Hot Lava officially Launching Today!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=TNXoTLn5ISs;full][/previewyoutube]

It’s happening! 

We’re incredibly happy (and proud) to say after many long years of development that Hot Lava is being officially released today. It has been an incredible journey to get to this point, and it’s something we couldn’t have done without your support.  

During the beta, the Hot Lava community helped us release 27 updates, and we are planning to continue to update and improve the game with everyone else who is joining us today. We saw an incredibly talented mapping community emerge, creating some awe-inspiring custom content. We also saw a speed running scene grow that is unlike anything we could have ever expected. The Hot Lava community has been so important to this game during development that we can’t help but thank you again.

It’s amazing to look back at how far we have come from the first version of Hot Lava. You are going to be playing a series of new worlds, Playground, Wholesale and Mastery that were added during the Beta, as well as a brand new world called “Basement” launching today. Our item system has moved away from randomized drops and towards a purely progression based unlock system. Mechanics have been refined over numerous iterations to create an incredibly deep player controller. We have also added full controller support, optimized performance and translated the game into 15 languages. But we still have so many exciting updates we can’t wait to share with you.

So with all that, we hope to see you all jumping on furniture very soon. And whatever you do… don’t touch the floor.

Hello friends!

Next week, on September 19, Hot Lava will be officially launching on Steam! To celebrate the upcoming launch, we have released a new G.A.T. episode for your viewing pleasure. It is available here:
Many of you have been playing and helping us test the Beta build that we have quietly been updating for the past year, and for launch we have a whole bunch of new features for you to check out.

The beta may be over, but we aren’t quite ready to call it quits yet. We will continue updating the game post-launch with new content, bug fixes, optimizations, and more. 

Thank you to everyone who has been following us all these years, and especially a huge shoutout to everyone who played and gave us feedback on the Beta, we couldn’t have done it without you!

[h1]The End Of Beta[/h1]
Today’s patch will be the last (major) one we do before the game launches into release. 

This has been an incredibly long road to releasing the game, but it was worth it. With the community's help I believe we have made something really special. Today I’m pleased to say this will be our last content patch before we release later this fall.

At launch we will be adding the long awaited “Basement” world for the game. We plan to continue to release content, features, and service the game post launch. We will also be adding Steam Achievements and Trading Cards with launch.

The Hot Lava mapping community has been creating amazing worlds for our game, and we have been actively awarding bounties for these maps to ensure we can include them in all versions of the game.

We will be removing the “gift box” and “ticket” systems. We will be replacing this with a system where you earn cosmetics at a rate of one randomized item per challenge. This will provide a better feedback loop for challenges, while maintaining the randomization that our game needs to make each players loadout feel unique. We will also be making major changes to the items available, and will be adding and removing many different items.

When we launch into release many aspects of the game will have a fresh start. Our levels and player mechanics have been growing and changing over this beta so much that we will reset all leaderboards. Inventories and progress will be incompatible with our new systems.

Those who have helped us test during this beta phase will be rewarded with a very special unique item to say “thank you”.

On that note, THANK YOU! The feedback, bug reports, and custom levels we have received from this community has been insanely influential to the development of this game. We could not have gotten here without you, and I can’t wait to show you what we have been working on for launch.

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24570646/816817e731365001f50eecfb0e75d36d4964f818.jpg[/img]

[h1]Development Update[/h1]
Some time ago Hot Lava closed sales to new players, and we began work on responding to the issues we saw in the game. We are working incredibly hard to finish Hot Lava and your continued feedback is a huge part of this. We are addressing issues in the new player experience, daily challenges, content fatigue, and enriching the Hot Lava world with more detailed and interactable environments. I wanted to take a moment to reassure everyone that we are working on tons of new and exciting content for future updates.  

[b]Coming soon[/b]: Playground: Bouncy Land course
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24570646/e54366543eaf309ccfe1085e929bc6156cc9f53b.png[/img]

We have also been hard at work on a new wave of characters with unique locomotion mechanics. These mechanics share similarities with the base character, but change some aspect to allow you to re-experience the game with a unique twist. They will also allow us to explore other fun movement mechanics missing from the base game, building on the foundation we have created with our GAT 'boosting' characters.

notes.title: Community Update
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/KO1J4P8.gif[/img]
[i]Hazard modeling the new football item set[/i]

As we are working hard on preparing Hot Lava for Early Access, I wanted to take some time to talk about some amazing things going on in the Hot Lava community.

[h1]Translations[/h1]
Yesterday we added support for user created translations of Hot Lava, and in under 24 hours we have seen 'Russian', 'Spanish', 'Turkish' and even 'Pirate' translation mods appear on the workshop! If you are interested in helping translate Hot Lava to another language, details can be found on the [url=https://forums.kleientertainment.com/forums/topic/95685-creatingusing-language-translations/]Klei forums[/url].  To view translations as they are added [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=382560&browsesort=trend&section=readytouseitems&admin_view=1&requiredtags%5B0%5D=Language&actualsort=trend&p=1&days=-1]visit the workshop[/url]

[h1]Custom Levels[/h1]
Through the Community Spotlight we have been highlighting some of the best and most accessible levels the community has been producing.  But please know this is just the tip of the iceberg- the workshop is littered with plenty of other creative, surprising, and challenging maps!
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=382560&browsesort=trend&section=readytouseitems&admin_view=1&requiredtags%5B0%5D=Level&actualsort=trend&p=1&days=90]View workshop maps[/url]

[h1]Modkit Update[/h1]
The Modkit is being updated today.  Support for multi-course levels,  game modes (like pogo), consistent export names (only retire leaderboard when you intend to), modkit friendly wall jumps and much more!  It's strongly recommended that you install the modkit to a new project and port existing maps over to avoid corruption. We will continue to build on and improve the Modkit based on your feedback.  The new modkit should go live in the next hour.

[h1]Community Tournament[/h1]
The speed running community for Hot Lava has become very competitive.  Many world records have been secured by fractions of a second.  A "Full School Run" tournament will be happening on the 22nd at 11am PST, 2pm EST,  7pm CET.  The competition will be streamed on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/dawnfinder]Twitch[/url].  If you think you have what it takes and want to sign up,  or are just interested in following the competitive scene an [url=https://discord.gg/ssCxKYu]event discord has been setup[/url].

[h1]Award Items[/h1] 
To show our appreciation towards the community we have added two award items.  The Wrench and Crown.  These items will be awarded for recipients of the Community Spotlight and the to the winners of select Community Competitions respectively.  Those who were featured in previous spotlights have retroactively received this award. Thank you for helping grow Hot Lava through your contributions!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/f5xBPvk.gif[/img]

[h1]Developer Stream[/h1]
Klei hosts a weekly developer stream where we talk about on of our games- and this week (like, right now) you can catch us talking about Hot Lava.  More details are available on the [url=https://forums.kleientertainment.com/forums/topic/95706-rhymes-with-play-hot-lava-update-dev-stream/]Klei forums[/url].

[h1]Hot Lava Discord[/h1]
If you are interested in becoming involved in any part of the Hot Lava community- or just want a chill place to hang out, please join me on the [url=https://discord.gg/RXDfHV4]Hot Lava Discord[/url].

Hey Everybody. 

Just wanted to make a quick note that open beta has begun for Hot Lava and explain a little about what that means, and where we are going to go from here. 

As of yesterday we gave out the game to over 12k people who signed up for the closed beta for Hot Lava. We're extremely thankful to everybody for their interest, thanks for all your helpful feedback and bug reports. 

As of today all new players can purchase the game from Steam. We have the price of the game set for 12.99. However, we are pricing the game at a discount to for people who purchase before launch at $9.99 for 2 copies of the game.

We're not quite ready for the massive rush of early-access yet. When a game goes into early-access it becomes part of the entire Steam ecosystem with curators, reviews, banner rotations and top sellers lists. So we're keeping a low profile for now until we believe we are ready for early-access. 

So, TL;DR

Buy it now for $9.99 - 2-for-1  - See you at School!

notes.title: Phase 3 begins, Update #2 Pogo Stick Trials and more!

Phase 3 is here, and we've got a bunch of cool stuff for you all!

We have a whole new type of game mode to play, cool new collectible cards, a bunch of new cosmetic items and of course a ton of balance changes, bug fixes and quality of life improvements. Also, coming soon, the Wholesale map will be available on a new public test branch! 

[h1]All previous testers will now find the game once again available in their Steam library where they can check out all the new stuff.[/h1]  As always, check back here on the forums and let us know what you think. If you find any bugs or issues report those bugs through the in-game menu or through the bug report tool here: https://forums.kleientertainment.com/forum/178-hot-lava-beta-bug-tracker/ 

We will continue to add new players through now until the end of Phase 3 on June 12. All eligible beta applicants will be given access on a first-come first-served basis up until closed beta ends. Most new players will be added between June 11th and June 12th. 

[h1]All beta participants can keep the game.[/h1] Yeah. We told you that you couldn't keep it, but we lied. Well technically we didn't lie, we just weren't totally sure we were going to give it to everybody... but we're sure now, thanks for your support!

[h1]Tuesday June 12th Begins Open Beta.[/h1] Not closed beta, not early access, what is it? Anybody interested in checking out Hot Lava but missed closed beta can purchase the game and get in on the action. 

The testing branch will be available on 6/12. We want players to focus on the normal game first, so we will be opening the Public Test Branch a bit later so we can have things nice and ready for Open beta on the 12th. We may have some of you come check it out early but it should be ready for everybody on the 12th. 

We're not done yet, keep up the good work and send us your feedback and bug reports!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24570646/cdaa2e1bd0225c14ed76e63c4a085f426d464dca.png[/img]
Hey Everybody

We are sending the next 3000 invites out. Those selected will now find Hot Lava in their steam Inventory. The test will run from today until next Tuesday on May 15th at which time the game will no longer be available to play until the next test period.

Since the last testing period, the team has been hard at work on making adjustments to the game in response to the feedback we received. The main concern we wanted to address based on tester feedback was that we wanted to give players a chance to rest a bit between levels while giving players better tools to socialize or practice routes and strategies in a more relaxed environment. 

Of course, we also added a bunch of quality of life improvements and bug fixes as well.  A lot of them. Those patch notes will come tomorrow. Once again, a special thanks to everybody who submitted bug reports and feedback in the last phase. 

Don't worry. More levels are coming, but right now our focus was to improve upon the experience, rather than adding additional content. We've been hard at work on upcoming levels - so we have that to look forward to after Phase 2. 

Tuesday May 8th will begin Phase 2 of closed beta. All previous participants will once again be granted access to the game and we will add an additional 3k participants. This phase will close on May 15th. 

[h1]Beta registration will close on May 11th[/h1] - At that time no further registrations will be accepted. We intend to let in all players before we reach early-access so don't miss your chance! If you have friends or are part of a community that would be interested, now is the time to let them know about Hot Lava.  

If you did not confirm your registration for Hot Lava Beta, please visit https://beta.playhotlava.com before May 11th. 

If you are not selected for this phase during Phase 2, don't worry. There will be more to come. 

We will release more information about plans for future tests after phase 2. 

For those of you who have not been invited yet, hang in there you will get your turn as well.
